## About
Reliance Roofing is a family owned and operated roofing company serving Austin and Central Texas. We handle everything from a simple repair to a complete re-roof, on homes as well as apartment and office complexes.
When a hailstorm or high wind comes through, the roof is rarely the only thing damaged. We can take care of siding, fences, decks, windows and fascia too, and we work through the insurance claim with you so you are not handling it alone.
We are fully insured and bonded, we install Owens Corning products as an Owens Corning Preferred Contractor, and we clean up when the job is done. Old composition shingles go to a recycling facility instead of a landfill.

## Services
- Roof replacement: Complete re-roofs using Owens Corning products, with composition shingles, metal, clay tile and flat roofing systems.
- Roof repair: If your roof only needs a repair, we can take care of it.
- Storm damage restoration: Hail and wind repairs beyond the roof, including siding, decks, fences, window screens, window replacements, AC combs and fascia.
- Commercial roofing: Re-roofs for property managers, with experience on apartment complexes and office complexes.
- Free roof inspection: Get in touch and we will set up an inspection of your roof.

## FAQ
Q: Can you help with my hail or wind insurance claim?
A: Yes. We can handle the issues that come with a hail or wind claim, including exterior repairs beyond the roof.

Q: What types of roofs do you install?
A: Composition shingles, metal, clay tile and flat roofing systems, for both homes and commercial properties.

Q: Are you insured?
A: Yes. Reliance Roofing is fully insured and bonded.

Q: What happens to my old shingles?
A: They go to a recycling facility instead of a landfill, where they are used to pave new roads.
